title: Reciprocal rank fusion
ask: Two searches rank the same documents. Fusion gives each document the sum of 1 / (k + rank) over the lists. Look at the two lists and predict the winner.

blocks.prompt: With k = {k}, which document comes first after fusion?
blocks.why: Say why, in one line, before you lock in.

blocks.label: k
blocks.note: A small k gives more weight to the top ranks.

blocks.text: First now: **{fused.0.id}**, with {fused.0.value}. Move k down to 1. Which document wins now? When does B lose first place, and why?
